Human_Cultist_Bhaal_Reaper
Barnz is a member of the Cult of Bhaal, and is found in the Abandoned Cistern in the Lower City Sewers during Act Three.

Involvement

Barnz guards the Sluice Gate in Abandoned Cistern with  Cilarea and  Kevo Phogge. Getting close to him triggers a fight.

Idle banter

  • Barnz
    To be left behind while our brothers and sisters hunt - it is an insult.
  • Cilarea
    This operation demands subtlety, brother. Not your peculiar form of devotion.
  • Barnz
    The Stone Lord has proven an effective instrument. A surprise, that he was not drawn to worship Lord Bhaal.
  • Cilarea
    He is a berserker. His life has been spent worshipping our Lord whether he wills it or not.
  • Barnz
    The Faceless grows weary of her current form - did you see her this morning?
  • Cilarea
    Slashing at her own face in the mirror. Doppelgangers are not meant to wear the same skin for too long - especially one so offensive to our Lord as that one.
  • Barnz
    How many of her Faceless has Lady Orin sent out to walk among us?
  • Cilarea
    That is not for us to know, brother. Any of devoted we speak to might be one of them - or the Lady Orin herself.
